journeys.title: A visitor increases the counter by one

journeys.title: A visitor decreases the counter and can go below zero

steps.expect: the Simple Counter screen is visible with the counter starting at 0 and the Increase (+1) and Reset buttons visible

journeys.title: A visitor resets the counter to zero
acceptance: clicking Reset after changing the counter visibly displays 0

acceptance.statement: the home route displays the exact title Simple Counter, the starting value 0, and the three visible buttons Increase (+1), Decrease (-1), and Reset
clicking Increase (+1) once from the initial state immediately displays the value 1
clicking Decrease (-1) once from the initial state immediately displays the value -1
after the counter has changed, clicking Reset immediately displays the value 0
the Increase (+1), Decrease (-1), and Reset buttons each expose accessible labels matching their visible text and show a visible focus state when focused by keyboard navigation
the counter page remains centered and usable at both mobile-width and desktop-width browser sizes
